ranked_candidates.title: Strengthen same-paid-set supervision result
ranked_candidates.status: Original 32-comparison family on inspected development data.
ranked_candidates.already_in_manuscript: Endpoints and four baseline wins present; positive within-ARC2 family interval omitted.
ranked_candidates.proposed_sentence: Using all already-paid MiniLM pairs raises FiQA nDCG@10 from 0.3075 to 0.3671 at the same 50% document coverage, a gain of 0.0596 with family-adjusted interval [0.0393, 0.0806].
limits: All-paid fitting uses 28,819 pairs, fixed uses 1,024. Summed-objective lambda=10 stays fixed, so effective regularization changes.
MiniLM all-paid ridge is marginally higher, 0.367263277; its comparison is unresolved.
E5 all-paid ARC2 loses to Procrustes and LA2M. This is encoder dependent.

ranked_candidates.title: Best development macro on every collection
ranked_candidates.already_in_manuscript: Overall/pair macros and 23/24 count present; collection macros absent.
ranked_candidates.proposed_sentence: ARC2 leads the six-method development panel on each collection macro, improving over Procrustes by 0.0269 on NanoNQ, 0.0316 on NanoHotpotQA, 0.0290 on NanoFEVER and 0.0099 on FiQA.
limits: Equal weights over two migrations and three budgets; these are not four newly significant tests.
All 24 partial DEV five-seed nDCG means remain below native Full-X and Full-Y.

ranked_candidates.title: Robustness of second correction
ranked_candidates.status: Original five-contrast mechanism family plus descriptive robustness.
ranked_candidates.already_in_manuscript: Macro gain/interval present; 22/24 signs and all-five-seed macro gains omitted.
ranked_candidates.proposed_sentence: The second correction improves 22 of 24 development condition means and adds 0.0069 macro nDCG@10 beyond one step, while both corrections remain absorbed into the same affine inference map.

limits: Two condition means are negative.
Saved seed-level overall gains range from 0.003827292 to 0.009036946; seeds are not independent collection replications.
No prospective one-step ablation. The ridge contrast jointly changes initialization/prior and tangent-target procedure.

ranked_candidates.title: Useful missing secondary prospective Recall result
ranked_candidates.status: Secondary descriptive Recall; original nominal 95% intervals, not primary-family tests.
ranked_candidates.already_in_manuscript: Prospective Recall values absent from main tables.
ranked_candidates.proposed_sentence: On prospective MiniLM, ARC2 has the highest Recall@100 point mean among all six adapters at every budget: 0.0896, 0.0953 and 0.0998 at 25%, 50% and 75% coverage.
limits: Nominal ARC2-minus-Procrustes intervals positive at 25/50%, unresolved at 75%; no 30-family Recall significance is established.
Native Full-Y Recall exceeds all ARC2 points. Full-X is exceeded by ARC2 at 50/75% as point estimates.
E5 Recall loses to Procrustes at all three budgets with negative nominal intervals; LA2M is also higher at 75%.

ranked_candidates.title: Clarify source-versus-destination operating point
ranked_candidates.already_in_manuscript: 75% versus destination Full-Y present; 50% versus source Full-X absent.
ranked_candidates.proposed_sentence: For prospective MiniLM migration, ARC2 reaches 0.5000 nDCG@10 at 50% coverage, above native source 0.4935; at 75% it reaches 0.5195 against destination-native 0.5203.
limits: Native references use their own query encoders; source queries remain a viable option when permitted.
Procrustes, LA2M and SimpleLinear have higher 50% nDCG point means than ARC2. No native equivalence or noninferiority test.
Prospective E5 source Full-X exceeds destination Full-Y. Destination encoders are not automatically relevance upgrades.

ranked_candidates.status: Posthoc shared-load timing; optional supplement only.

B3/B4 systems studies are unrun.

ranked_candidates.title: Positive MiniLM counterpart to mixed-gallery reversal
ranked_candidates.status: Paired descriptive diagnostic on saved fitted galleries.
ranked_candidates.already_in_manuscript: MiniLM ARC2 before/after present; comparator behavior omitted.
ranked_candidates.proposed_sentence: On all-paid MiniLM/FiQA, true-vector replacement raises ARC2 nDCG@10 from 0.3510 to 0.3671, whereas Procrustes falls from 0.3496 to 0.3334 and LA2M from 0.3506 to 0.3389.
limits: Retain opposite E5 ARC2 behavior. No unique causal score-bias mechanism or calibration fix proved.

G reuses older frozen fits; do not mix fresh R3 Converter endpoints.

limits: Tolerance agreement is not byte-identical coefficients.
Finite checks are not universal proof or additional relevance evidence.

cost_accounting: Count unique destination document exposure as |A union S|, anchors included; fitting-pair count differs from paid coverage.
Fixed fitting uses 1,024 anchors; paid nonanchors supply replacement only. All-paid FiQA/50% fits the same 28,819 paid pairs.
Coverage is floor(rho*N); TREC 25/50/75% means 42,833/85,666/128,499 unique destination documents.
Cached fit/rank phases perform zero new physical document encodes. B2 full frozen-vector acquisition is a separate stage; exposure is not total pipeline encoding cost.
Proxy-only diagnostics still require target fitting pairs.
Destination query encoding, fitting workspace and full 768-dimensional index storage are outside coefficient-byte/document-exposure metrics.
Native Full-X uses source queries and may remain viable if allowed; required destination queries change the operating constraint.
gaps: No independent superiority over closest Procrustes/LA2M.
No prior-matched control isolates tangent target from initialization/prior.
No tested minimum coverage/retention threshold or interpolated saving.
No physical-100K, traffic replay or serving-SLO measurements.
recommendation: Add the E5 discrete cross-budget operating point, original MiniLM within-ARC2 all-paid interval, and secondary prospective MiniLM Recall context if space permits. Collection breadth is an optional short strengthening sentence. Keep directional quality with compact affine inference central; avoid a study inventory.
